metadata.method: Integration observations of rule-first routing, typed-choice fallback and interaction-sticky reuse; not a systematic accuracy benchmark.
limitations: Approximately 300ms is routing decision latency, not TTFT, response generation time or coding completion time.
A few routing examples do not establish best-model selection or accuracy for a production distribution.
TypeSafe receives the routing state/request; downstream Azure deployment does not imply all request data stays in Azure.
Protocol/BYOK behavior is historical reported behavior and does not establish this harness's live or isolated-credential readiness.
No aggregate accuracy, billed usage or verified cost dataset is present for this integration report.
